title: Idle fidgets and visitors for still characters
description: Give a character who stands still something to do (look around, stretch, yawn …) and, after a while, a small visitor (a butterfly on the snout, a bird that lands and stares, a crab at their feet), so held shots and idle play never look frozen. Component: 3d/godot/world_life/idle_scheduler.gd (world-life module). Derived from ShammyVerse.

optional_ai: Wiring the component into the game; a person reviews the result in play.

godot.title: Godot 4 console executable (Movie Maker)

stages.title: Vendor the world-life module
stages.description: Copy the kit and components into the game with a SHA-256 lock per file.

stages.title: Wire the component
stages.description: Game code: Name the fidgets (with durations) and visitors the game can play. Each frame call `idle.update(delta, still)`; it returns this frame's starts (`fidget`, `visitor`). Play the fidget's motion using `progress()` (0..1); spawn the visitor's short scene. Moving cancels the fidget. `fidget_after`, `fidget_gap`, `visitor_after`, `visitor_gap`.

stages.title: Test
stages.description: Headless test on a fixed clock (the GameCore component test, plus the game's own).

checks.title: A fidget starts after standing still and moving cancels it

stages.title: Review in play
stages.description: The requester reviews the result in play or in a showcase shot; notes go to the design log.

checks.title: Visitors read clearly in a close-up
